_doc: Kids section + ruqyah. References only: Quran passages by surah/ayah (text comes from content/quran, KFGQPC v18), duas by Hisn al-Muslim item or HadeethEnc id (text copied from those files by tools/kids_build.py, never typed here). Video/audio files are archive.org items (metadata snapshots in raw/). Titles are UI labels. Sources: docs/CONTENT_SOURCES.md (never shown in the app). Build: python3 tools/kids_build.py

ruqyah.source: Ibn Baz, Majmu' Fatawa wa Maqalat 6/368 (binbaz.org.sa fatwa 1694 «الدواء الشرعي للسحر»; same list in fatwa 2492 «كيفية علاج المسحور»)

ruqyahKids.source: islamqa.info fatwa 104454 «الرقية الشرعية للأطفال» (Bukhari 3371, Bukhari 5748, Tirmidhi 2058); dua text = Hisn al-Muslim chapter «ما يعوذ به الأولاد»
